title: PETC Lane Daily Quota
description: Response from GET /api/lanes/me/quota. Capacity resets at midnight Asia/Manila. A slot is reserved while LTMS processing is in flight, consumed only by an LTMS-accepted CEC, and released after REJECTED or DEAD. Same-test corrected retries are idempotent and do not consume another slot.

remaining.description: Available slots after accepted and reserved counts
